name: Mitchell Mecham
bio: Builds worlds you can get lost in. Emberwake is a love letter to retro dungeon crawlers, made so a few friends can clear dungeons together from a browser tab.

name: Logan Lay
bio: Computer science student with a curiosity for data science. Made Dot Slayer, a fast arcade arena that works on a phone so nobody at the party sits out.

name: Soroosh Noorzad
bio: An all-time student in every field. Made Own the Night, a neon night-racing game for up to six players, on a laptop or a phone, with AI that actually races back. Also made Bastion, a gunpowder-era tower defense.
